parameters.name: X-Fc-Account-Id
parameters.description: The ID of your Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Date
parameters.description: The time on which the function is invoked. The format of the value is: **EEE,d MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT**.

parameters.name: X-Fc-Trace-Id
parameters.description: The unique ID of the trace.

parameters.name: qualifier
parameters.description: Service alias or LATEST. Other versions are not supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fc-open get-function-on-demand-config --service-name demo-service --function-name demoFunction --qualifier prod --x-fc-account-id 1880770869020000 --x-fc-date Wed,_11_May_2022_09:00:00_GMT --x-fc-trace-id asdf0000 --api-version 2021-04-06 --region cn-hangzhou
